definitions.explanation: An artist who creates three-dimensional works of art by carving, modeling, or casting materials such as stone, wood, metal, or clay.

examples.japanese: ミケランジェロは{有名|ゆうめい}な{彫刻家|ちょうこくか}だ。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{彫刻家|ちょうこくか}を{目指|めざ}して{美術|びじゅつ}{大学|だいがく}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: She entered art school aiming to become a sculptor.

examples.japanese: この{公園|こうえん}には{有名|ゆうめい}な{彫刻家|ちょうこくか}の{作品|さくひん}が{展示|てんじ}されている。
examples.english: Works by famous sculptors are displayed in this park.

notes:
RELATED ART PROFESSIONS:
・{画家|がか} (painter)
・{陶芸家|とうげいか} (potter/ceramicist)
・{工芸家|こうげいか} (craftsman/craftsperson)
・{芸術家|げいじゅつか} (artist - general term)

SUFFIX NOTE: The suffix ～{家|か} is commonly used for professions, especially those involving expertise or artistry: {作家|さっか} (writer), {音楽家|おんがくか} (musician), {写真家|しゃしんか} (photographer).

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{彫刻|ちょうこく} (sculpture - the art form or artwork)
・{彫|ほ}る (to carve/sculpt)
